rows.commentary: 0.1: Binura Fernando targets the full length and draws the forward prod from Sahibzada Farhan, who steers an edge down to third man for a single.
0.2: Dot ball from Binura Fernando to Fakhar Zaman.
0.3: Binura Fernando delivers back of a length outside off, and Fakhar Zaman watches it sail through untouched.
0.4: Binura Fernando targets the channel outside off, and Fakhar Zaman stays rooted to his crease, pushing it cleanly towards the cover fielder.
0.5: Binura Fernando targets the channel with a fuller length, and Fakhar Zaman gets firmly behind the line to dead-bat the delivery into the pitch.
0.6: Binura Fernando offers width on a length, and Fakhar Zaman seizes the moment by staying leg-side and flaying it across the turf to the sweeper cover boundary.
1.1: Nuwan Thushara begins his spell with a back-of-a-length delivery, punched fiercely by Sahibzada Farhan toward covers where a sharp stop saves certain four runs.
1.2: Nuwan Thushara spears in a length ball outside off that keeps alarmingly low, completely beating Sahibzada Farhan underneath the bat.
1.3: Nuwan Thushara angles a full delivery directly into the pads, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to tickle it comfortably down to backward square leg for a single.
1.4: Nuwan Thushara strays too straight, and Fakhar Zaman dispatches the ball away to the backward square leg boundary with crisp timing.
1.5: Nuwan Thushara strays on the pads, allowing Fakhar Zaman to whip it into the leg side for a couple of comfortable runs.
1.6: Nuwan Thushara misses his yorker with a juicy full toss, and Fakhar Zaman punishes it straight down the ground with a textbook straight bat for four.
2.1: Binura Fernando delivers back of a length, angling across, and Sahibzada Farhan gets right behind the line to block it solidly.
2.2: Binura Fernando induces a false stroke as Sahibzada Farhan charges and lofts it, but Dikshana spills a tough diving chance to his right.
2.3: Binura Fernando targets the pads on a length, and Sahibzada Farhan simply fends it away into the leg side.
2.4: Binura Fernando is punished as Sahibzada Farhan dispatches the ball away to the backward square leg boundary for four.
2.5: Binura Fernando delivers full and wide outside off, drawing Sahibzada Farhan into a desperate heave that sails harmlessly past the bat.
2.6: Binura Fernando spears this full into the toes, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to flick it smartly away toward backward square leg for a sharp couple of runs.
3.1: Nuwan Thushara digs this short delivery into the middle, and Fakhar Zaman responds by whipping a flat pull straight to the fielder stationed deep at backward square leg for a single.

3.2: Nuwan Thushara locks onto a much tighter channel with a clever slower ball on a length, inducing Sahibzada Farhan to push it softly onto the turf where it cannons directly into the bowler's stumps without a run.
3.3: Nuwan Thushara attacks the stumps once more, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to turn the ball away sharply toward backward square leg to collect a single.
3.4: Nuwan Thushara rolls his fingers across a clever slower ball, outfoxing Fakhar Zaman who backs away into empty space and misses completely.
3.5: Nuwan Thushara digs it in short toward the body, extracting a mistimed pull from Fakhar Zaman that trickles away for a single.
3.6: Nuwan Thushara deceives Sahibzada Farhan with a slower delivery, drawing a top-edge that Jayawardene inexplicably spills at short third.
4.1: Maheesh Theekshana offers a full delivery on off-stump, and Sahibzada Farhan strokes it firmly toward mid-on to collect a single.
4.2: Maheesh Theekshana floats up a deceptive slow off-break, which Fakhar Zaman pushes crisply to the right of the bowler for a dot ball.
4.3: Maheesh Theekshana fires it through quicker at the stumps, Fakhar Zaman creates room to slash it sharply toward cover point, racing across for a sharp single after the initial half-stop.
4.4: Maheesh Theekshana darts a full delivery into the middle, Sahibzada Farhan gets it away with a wristy flick toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
4.5: Maheesh Theekshana tosses it up on the leg stump, and Fakhar Zaman drops to one knee to dispatch a fierce sweep behind square for a boundary.
4.6: Dot ball from Maheesh Theekshana to Fakhar Zaman.
5.1: Eshan Malinga slides it through, and Sahibzada Farhan pounces, carving the delivery away to the deep extra cover boundary with supreme authority.
5.2: Eshan Malinga hits the fifth-stump corridor with sharp control, inducing a hurried cut from Sahibzada Farhan that deflects off the inner half into the pitch.
5.3: Eshan Malinga feeds it full outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan clears his leg, lifting it clean through the line for a single bounce to the long-off boundary.
5.4: Eshan Malinga hunts the base of the off stump with a screaming yorker, squeezed out to mid-off by Sahibzada Farhan for a single.
5.5: Eshan Malinga digs it in short at the body, and Fakhar Zaman wrenches it away toward backward square leg with one hand slipping off the handle for a scampered run.
5.6: Eshan Malinga pulls out the change of pace, inducing a mistimed prod to mid-off from Sahibzada Farhan as they sprint through for a sharp single.
6.1: Sahibzada Farhan does not score off Maheesh Theekshana.
6.2: Maheesh Theekshana drops it slightly back, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to pounce on the length and muscle a pull into the deep mid-wicket turf for a pair.

6.3: Maheesh Theekshana loops it up, and Sahibzada Farhan launches a ferocious aerial assault straight over deep mid-wicket, clearing the rope with ease to strengthen this partnership with Fakhar Zaman.
6.4: Theekshana loops it through, and Farhan works it cleanly toward the deep square leg boundary to jog through for a single.
6.5: Maheesh Theekshana strikes as Fakhar Zaman holes out to Kamindu Mendis, departing for 22 with four boundaries to his name.

6.6: Maheesh Theekshana loops it full and into the drift, Maaz Sadaqat plays ahead of the line with a closed face, squirting a leading edge safely short of the fielder at short cover to cap off a brilliant over.
7.1: Dasun Shanaka delivers to Sahibzada Farhan, who nudges it away toward mid-wicket to jog through for a comfortable single.
7.2: Shanaka slips it full and angling inward from round the wicket, pinning Sadaqat on the pads as the inside edge takes the blow.
7.3: Shanaka watches Sadaqat punch this delivery down toward long-on to comfortably collect a single.
7.4: Dasun Shanaka digs it in slightly shorter from over the wicket, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to pull the angling delivery away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
7.5: Dasun Shanaka strips the pace off a clever delivery from around the wicket, targeting the stumps as Maaz Sadaqat misses his sweeping stroke and cops the ball flush on the pad.
7.6: Dasun Shanaka drops the length on Maaz Sadaqat, who nudges it cleanly towards mid-on to rotate the strike.
8.1: Maaz Sadaqat dances down the track to loft Maheesh Theekshana straight down the ground, but Kamindu races across the turf to execute a desperate sliding stop and save the boundary.
8.2: Maheesh Theekshana loops this delivery up invitingly on the off stump, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to stroke the ball cleanly toward the long-off region for a single.
8.3: Sahibzada Farhan does not score off Maheesh Theekshana.
8.4: Theekshana loops it into the arc, and Sahibzada Farhan crouches low before launching it high and handsome over mid-wicket for a maximum.
8.5: Theekshana loops it up, and Sahibzada Farhan crouches low to deposit the full delivery over long-on for a maximum.
8.6: Theekshana pulls his length back, and Farhan clears room on the back foot to carve the ball through the covers for a brisk couple.
9.1: Eshan Malinga delivers to Maaz Sadaqat, who angles a single down toward short third man.
9.2: Eshan Malinga delivers a slower bouncer that Sahibzada Farhan swivels to pull with immaculate control, collecting a single at deep square leg to bring up his twelfth half-century in the format.
9.3: Eshan Malinga drops it short and wide outside off, and Maaz Sadaqat violently slashes it high over the backward point boundary for six.
9.4: Eshan Malinga searches for control with a slower off-target delivery, dragging it well wide of Maaz Sadaqat to hand the batting side an extra.
9.4: Maaz Sadaqat connects cleanly with Eshan Malinga's offering, lofting the ball all the way to the long-off boundary for four.
9.5: Eshan Malinga fires it wide and on a length, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to stretch out and drill a single hard toward deep extra cover.
9.6: No run for Sahibzada Farhan off Eshan Malinga.
10.1: Dasun Shanaka drops it on a length, but Maaz Sadaqat skips down the track with immense authority, pummeling the ball straight back over long-on and clearing the ropes for a magnificent maximum.
10.2: Dasun Shanaka drops the slower yorker wide of off and Maaz Sadaqat guides it past backward point for a single.
10.3: Dasun Shanaka drops it back outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan aggressively slaps the delivery straight to the extra cover fielder.
10.4: Dasun Shanaka maintains his length, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to work the ball away into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
10.5: Dasun Shanaka unleashes a pinpoint yorker straight at the timber, forcing Maaz Sadaqat to drop low and desperately squeeze it away into the turf just in front of the scrambling keeper.
10.6: Dasun Shanaka drops the slower delivery outside off, and Maaz Sadaqat executes a clever reverse paddle past short third for four.
11.1: Binura Fernando rolls his fingers across the seam with a wide, angled slower delivery, and Sahibzada Farhan stretches out to miscue his drive straight towards extra cover for a single.
11.2: Binura Fernando targets the wide channel, tempting Maaz Sadaqat into a sweeping movement across the crease that ends in thin air.
11.3: Binura Fernando delivers a loose full toss outside off, and Maaz Sadaqat carves it expertly past backward point for a boundary.
11.4: Binura Fernando steams in and Maaz Sadaqat guides it crisply out toward sweeper cover for a single.
11.5: Binura Fernando delivers into the arc, and Sahibzada Farhan launches it high and clean between mid-wicket and long-on for a maximum.
11.6: Binura Fernando rolls his fingers across the seam wide of off stump, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to slap the slower ball firmly toward extra cover for a brisk single.
12.1: Kamindu Mendis drifts a slow full toss into the pads, safely nudged down to long-on as the umpire extends his arm for the no-ball.
12.1: Maaz Sadaqat skips down the track with immense intent, dispatching Kamindu Mendis all the way over the ropes for a maximum.
12.2: Kamindu Mendis is carved away square, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to hustle back hard for a couple of runs toward deep backward point.
12.3: Kamindu Mendis drops it on a length outside off, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to carve it away to deep point for a couple of runs.
12.4: No run for Maaz Sadaqat off Kamindu Mendis.
12.5: Mendis tosses it up, and Sadaqat safely pushes the ball away toward deep backward point to pick up a single.
12.6: Kamindu Mendis slides one driftingly down the leg-side, leaving Sahibzada Farhan to watch it pass safely into the gloves.
12.6: Kamindu Mendis tosses this one wide of off-stump, inviting Sahibzada Farhan to stretch out and drill it down to long-off for a single.
13.1: Nuwan Thushara steams in and pushes it full, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to punch the ball cleanly into the cover region for a single.
13.2: Nuwan Thushara floats up the slower delivery around off, Maaz Sadaqat commits far too early to the drive and somehow puts down a glaring return catch.
13.3: Dot ball from Nuwan Thushara to Maaz Sadaqat.
13.4: Thushara takes the pace right off and hits a back-of-a-length delivery into the stumps, allowing Sadaqat to step down and guide it straight to short third.
13.5: Thushara executes another clever slower ball, choking the batter for four consecutive dots as Sadaqat aborts a planned scoop and fails to connect.

13.6: Nuwan Thushara delivers a deceptive slower ball from over the wicket that catches Maaz Sadaqat on the front pad, prompting an unsuccessful review after replays confirm the ball pitched well outside leg stump.
14.1: Dasun Shanaka drops the slower delivery wide outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan miscues his fierce lofted drive safely into the open space between the cover fielders for a single.
14.2: Dasun Shanaka comes from round the wicket, pinning a full delivery outside off that Maaz Sadaqat drills firmly down to long-off for a single.
14.3: Shanaka offers one right in the arc, and Farhan drops deep into his crease to launch it cleanly over the umpire's head for a maximum.
14.4: Shanaka strays again, and Farhan deftly steers the ball away down to fine leg for a boundary.
14.5: Dasun Shanaka outclasses Sahibzada Farhan, who departs for a blistering 73 off 44 balls after picking out Maheesh Theekshana in the deep.
14.6: Dasun Shanaka fires it into the pads, allowing Hasan Nawaz to work it away into the deep and scamper back easily for a brace.
15.1: Maheesh Theekshana loops it up and Maaz Sadaqat launches it all the way over long-off for a maximum.
15.2: Maheesh Theekshana fires it flat and short outside off, Maaz Sadaqat waits to carve it away, only for a brilliant dive at backward point to deny him.
15.3: Maheesh Theekshana attacks the stumps with a length delivery, but Maaz Sadaqat clears his front leg and launches it monstrously over midwicket for six.
15.4: Maheesh Theekshana runs in to Maaz Sadaqat, who dispatches the delivery all the way to long-off.
15.5: Wide from Maheesh Theekshana to Maaz Sadaqat.
15.5: Theekshana fires it through, Sadaqat drills the delivery out to extra cover and scampers across for a single.
15.6: Theekshana fires this into the pads, and Nawaz stays back to whip it across the turf through midwicket for a couple of runs.
Maaz Sadaqat reaches a brilliant half-century, bringing up his fifty off just 30 balls to keep the scoreboard ticking!
16.1: Eshan Malinga bends into his delivery stride, floating a slower short ball angling away that leaves Maaz Sadaqat reaching into the empty air before the umpire extends his arms.
16.1: Eshan Malinga delivers to Maaz Sadaqat, who slices it aerially as the fielder at deep backward point charges in with a breathtaking effort to limit them to a single.
16.2: Eshan Malinga steams in to Hasan Nawaz, who quietly nudges the ball away toward the cover region to rotate the strike.
16.3: Eshan Malinga delivers to Maaz Sadaqat, who carves the ball away into the vast expanse of deep extra cover, galloping back for a brisk two runs.
16.4: Eshan Malinga digs it in short, finding an under-edge as Maaz Sadaqat tries to pull, dribbling on the bounce through to the keeper.
16.5: Eshan Malinga outsmarts Maaz Sadaqat with a clever slower delivery as the batsman shuffles across for a scoop, skewing the ball harmlessly off the edge down the pitch.
16.6: Eshan Malinga delivers and Maaz Sadaqat sends it sailing over the ropes for a colossal maximum.
17.1: Binura Fernando rolls his fingers across the seam, tempting Hasan Nawaz wide of off, and the batsman steers it toward backward point where a fumble gifts the single.
17.2: Binura Fernando floats up a slower bouncer wide of off stump, inviting Maaz Sadaqat to clear the infield with a ferocious heave over extra cover for three comfortable runs.
17.3: Binura Fernando rolls his fingers across a slower delivery, tempting Hasan Nawaz into a fierce horizontal-bat stroke through point for a single.
17.4: Binura Fernando delivers a wide yorker outside off, and Maaz Sadaqat drills it firmly out to sweeper cover for a single.
17.5: Binura Fernando pitches it up and Hasan Nawaz dispatches it all the way over deep extra cover for a maximum.
17.6: Binura Fernando charges into his delivery stride, sending it down to Hasan Nawaz who swats it forcefully toward deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
18.1: Nuwan Thushara unleashes the 18.1 delivery, serving it up to Maaz Sadaqat who scoops it cleanly away to the fine leg boundary for four.
18.2: Nuwan Thushara targets the slot, enticing Maaz Sadaqat into an overzealous heave that collapses his shape and trickles away via a thick inside edge toward short fine.
18.3: Nuwan Thushara jams it in near the blockhole, where Hasan Nawaz carves it out to long-off for a single that brings up the double-century for Pakistan.
18.4: Nuwan Thushara strays, and Maaz Sadaqat punishes it with a crisp stroke racing away to the sweeper cover fence.
18.5: Nuwan Thushara delivers into the arc, and Maaz Sadaqat whips it powerfully away to the deep square leg boundary for four runs.
18.6: Thushara offers up a full toss just outside the off stump, and Sadaqat swings fiercely, dragging it off the inside edge away toward deep backward square for two.
19.1: Eshan Malinga steams in at the death, bangs this one into the pitch, and Hasan Nawaz hurriedly pushes it toward mid-off to scamper through for a single.
19.2: Eshan Malinga rolls his fingers across the seam with a slower short delivery wide of off stump, leaving Maaz Sadaqat flailing as he tries to carve it away through the empty air.
19.3: Malinga spears this full delivery outside off, and Sadaqat forces it straight to extra cover where a fumble gifts them a pair.
19.4: Malinga charges in again, and Sadaqat works this neatly into the deep square leg region to scamper back for another two.
19.5: Eshan Malinga slips in a deceptive slower short ball that angles away sharply, leaving Maaz Sadaqat flailing into thin air.
19.6: Eshan Malinga claims the prize as Maaz Sadaqat perishes for a magnificent 96, top-edging an intended glory shot safely into the hands of Dasun Shanaka.
0.1: Salman Mirza steams in to deliver the opening ball, driving a sharp length into Lahiru Udara, who pushes it firmly toward mid-off for a brisk single.
0.2: Salman Mirza drops it on a hard length just outside off, and Sineth Jayawardena stays in his crease to block it dead into the off-side.
0.3: Salman Mirza hurls it full and straight, catching Sineth Jayawardena back in his crease to turn it away for a single.
0.4: Salman Mirza rolls his fingers over a slower length delivery on middle and leg, safely defended toward midwicket.
0.5: Salman Mirza offers width and Lahiru Udara capitalizes, flashing the ball away to the deep extra cover boundary.
0.6: Salman Mirza strikes as Pakistan successfully review a caught-behind appeal after a sharp short ball clips Lahiru Udara's glove on its way through.
1.1: Naseem Shah unleashes a sharp delivery that veers wildly wide outside the off stump, allowing Sineth Jayawardena to comfortably watch it sail past.
1.1: Naseem Shah tests Sineth Jayawardena immediately with a sharp delivery climbing into the ribs, forcing a hurried pull that thuds straight into the batter's glove.
1.2: Naseem Shah strays slightly with his length and Sineth Jayawardena punishes it instantly, carving the ball away with authority toward the deep backward point boundary.
1.3: Naseem Shah charges in and fires it down, guided away by Sineth Jayawardena toward deep backward point for a single.
1.4: Naseem Shah lands it back of a length outside off, and Kusal Mendis stays rooted to the crease to dead-bat it down.
1.5: Naseem Shah extracts menacing seam movement away from a back-of-a-length delivery, leaving Kusal Mendis groping helplessly into the void.
1.6: Naseem Shah lands it back of a length outside off, extracting inward movement as Kusal Mendis rapidly brings his bat down to drop it straight into the pitch.
2.1: Salman Mirza hides the pace wide of off stump, drawing a frustrated drive and a clean miss from Sineth Jayawardena.
2.2: Sineth Jayawardena does not score off Salman Mirza.
2.3: Salman Mirza drops it short, and Sineth Jayawardena brutally pulls it away, absolutely smoking it to the boundary for four.
2.4: Salman Mirza angles it in from back of a length to cramp Sineth Jayawardena, who inadvertently steers an inside edge past leg and away to the fine boundary.
2.5: Sineth Jayawardena clears room against Salman Mirza's pace and thrashes the length delivery through the cover region for three consecutive boundaries.
2.6: Dot ball from Salman Mirza to Sineth Jayawardena.
3.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires it in, Kusal Mendis guides it firmly away to deep backward point for a single.
3.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa hits a hard back-of-a-length trajectory, angling sharply away outside off as Sineth Jayawardena swishes hard on the pull and connects with nothing but thin air.
3.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drifts it across the channel on a back of a length, allowing Sineth Jayawardena to angle the face and guide it down to deep backward point for a single.
3.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa offers up another length delivery, and Kusal Mendis neatly glides it straight to short third man before sprinting across for the run.
3.5: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops it back of a length, and Sineth Jayawardena defends it solidly straight back down the pitch.
3.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa finds the angle away from Sineth Jayawardena, who stays anchored in defense before a thick edge takes it rolling down to short third.
4.1: Naseem Shah rolls his fingers across the seam, floating a slower delivery down the leg side that Kusal Mendis tickles softly behind square for a single.
4.2: Naseem Shah unleashes a deceptive slower short delivery wide of off stump, allowing Sineth Jayawardena to guide it away with a sharp cut toward deep point for a single.
4.3: Naseem Shah unleashes a venomous bouncer that whistles past Kusal Mendis, instantly drawing a sharp, optimistic appeal from the fielding side.
4.4: Naseem Shah unleashes a back-of-the-length delivery outside off that Kusal Mendis aggressively thrashes away to deep backward point for a single.
4.5: Sineth Jayawardena does not score off Naseem Shah.
4.6: Naseem Shah lands it full on off stump, inviting Sineth Jayawardena to punch it firmly toward sweeper cover for a scampered couple.
5.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa unfurls a clever slower delivery well wide of off, inviting Kusal Mendis to skip down the track and hammer a fierce drive straight to the extra cover fielder.

5.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa serves it right in the slot, and Kusal Mendis commits completely to a ferocious heave, only to lose his shape entirely as the ball cannons off the inside edge and crashes into the pad.
5.3: Dot ball from Mohammad Imran Randhawa to Sineth Jayawardena.
5.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires it in on a length outside leg, catching Sineth Jayawardena on the back leg as the pull shot is missed, allowing a scrambled leg bye to gully.
5.5: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires in a scorching yorker at the base of the stumps, which Kusal Mendis hurriedly digs out and squeezes away toward deep backward square leg for a single.
5.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa entices Sineth Jayawardena into a mistimed pull once too often, ending a 22-run stay as Fakhar Zaman gratefully accepts the catch in the outfield.
6.1: Abrar Ahmed rushes one through flat into the stumps, and Kusal Mendis stays back to poke it firmly into the leg side, scrambling across for a quick single to long-on.
6.2: Abrar Ahmed drifts the googly into the stumps from round the wicket, and Kamindu Mendis meets it solidly with a forward prod.
6.3: Abrar tosses it up outside off, and Kamindu Mendis strokes it wide of deep extra cover to comfortably collect a brace.
6.4: Abrar Ahmed drifts it onto middle and leg, prompting Kamindu Mendis to twist into a reverse sweep that trickles away to deep backward point for a single.
6.5: Abrar Ahmed drifts it short to Kusal Mendis, who rocks back swiftly to drag the pull away toward long-on for a single.
6.6: Abrar Ahmed drifts it short, Kamindu Mendis pulls it into the deep air, and Saim Ayub backpedals to take the catch only to tumble backward onto the boundary cushions for a six.
7.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops it short and wide outside off, guiding Kusal Mendis to thump it away square through point for a single.
7.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa pitches it into the pads, and Kamindu Mendis clips it away toward deep square leg to rotate the strike.
7.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa hits the length, Kusal Mendis obliges with a flat push into the ring, and Khawaja Nafay executes a sharp catch to dismiss him for nine.
7.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa digs this way too short, watching the ball sail harmlessly over Sahan Arachchige's head for a wide.
7.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa strikes as Sahan Arachchige falls for a duck, offering a catch to Khawaja Nafay.
7.5: Mohammad Imran Randhawa slides it through to Dasun Shanaka, who steers a single down towards third man.
7.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa bangs this hard length delivery into middle and leg, and Kamindu Mendis stays rooted to his crease to block it dead.
8.1: Abrar Ahmed darts a flat delivery outside off, and Dasun Shanaka retreats to club it aerially toward long-on for a single.
8.2: Abrar Ahmed flights it up on off stump, inviting Kamindu Mendis to charge down and slam a crisp drive that is brilliantly intercepted by a diving cover fielder.
8.3: Abrar Ahmed flights one outside off as Kamindu Mendis leans smoothly into a square drive, carving the ball past a desperate full-length dive at deep point and all the way to the boundary.
8.4: Abrar Ahmed slides it into the pads, allowing Kamindu Mendis to nudge it away and scamper through for a single.
8.5: Abrar Ahmed tosses this one right into the stumps, and Dasun Shanaka holds his ground to block it solidly.
8.6: Abrar Ahmed fires it through quicker, but Dasun Shanaka marches down the track and launches it high over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
9.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drifts it across the right-hander, and Kamindu Mendis opens the face straight to backward point for a dot.
9.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa extracts sharp movement away from a length, pinning Kamindu Mendis firmly to his crease.
9.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa slides the length across the crease, tempting Kamindu Mendis into a back-foot punch that takes a thick outside edge scurrying down to third man for a single.
9.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa beats Dasun Shanaka as the batsman shuffles across and fails to clip a length ball angling tightly past the leg stump.
9.5: Dot ball from Mohammad Imran Randhawa to Dasun Shanaka.
9.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa serves a sharp, angled length delivery that Dasun Shanaka calmly works behind square to rotate the strike.
10.1: Saim Ayub lures Dasun Shanaka into a premeditated slog sweep, extracting a fateful top edge that settles safely into the hands of Abrar Ahmed at short fine leg.
10.2: Saim Ayub fires one into the stumps from a length, gently pushed by Wickramasinghe toward mid-wicket to pick up a single and get off the mark.
10.3: Saim Ayub drops it short on the stumps, and Kamindu Mendis swivels briskly to pull it away toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
10.4: Saim Ayub tosses this one up on a length, and Wickramasinghe bunts it neatly to cover point to scamper through safely for one.
10.5: Saim Ayub spears this in, skidding off the inner edge as Kamindu Mendis tries to work it away, only for Naseem to swoop smartly at short fine leg.
10.6: Saim Ayub darts this quicker into the timber, allowing Kamindu Mendis to bunt it down toward long-on for a brisk single.
11.1: Shadab Khan drifts the googly wide, prompting Kamindu Mendis to drop deep and slice it past backward point for a single.
11.2: Shadab Khan drops it short on the stumps, and Wickramasinghe swivels to muscle the pull toward deep square leg.
11.3: Shadab Khan flights it up, and Kamindu Mendis lofts him down the ground for four runs to long-on.
11.4: Shadab Khan drifts this short one away outside off, and Kamindu Mendis cuts it straight to the ring fielder at cover.
11.5: Shadab Khan strikes as Kamindu Mendis skies it to Hasan Nawaz to depart for 23.
11.6: Shadab Khan drops it on a length outside off and Maheesh Theekshana solidly pushes it away with no run given.
12.1: Saim Ayub fires this one in quicker on the stumps, and Wickramasinghe clips it smoothly away behind square on the leg-side for a single.
12.2: Saim Ayub fires one in and induces a gentle nudge to the square leg region from Maheesh Theekshana.
12.3: Maheesh Theekshana drops back against Saim Ayub and drills a single down towards long-on.
12.4: Saim Ayub loops it up outside off and Wickramasinghe steps across to dead-bat it straight back to the bowler.
12.5: Saim Ayub drops it short on the stumps, allowing Wickramasinghe to work it firmly into the empty mid-wicket expanse for a couple of runs.
12.6: Saim Ayub tosses it full on off stump, and Wickramasinghe wrists it toward deep square where Khawaja Nafay gives chase for a single.
13.1: Shadab Khan keeps it tight, inviting a single placed straight toward short third man.
